# Requirements Stage Rules

- Capture only requirements supported by the source story or explicit human clarification.
- Separate functional requirements, non-functional requirements, assumptions, dependencies, and open questions.
- Write acceptance criteria in behavior-focused language that QA can convert into executable tests.
- Summarize the source story, scope, and relevant constraints before finalizing the requirement list.
- Preserve unresolved questions explicitly instead of guessing at missing business or technical details.
- Keep the artifact approval-ready and restricted to the active story scope.
